correctness.rationale: Weak-composition c_k(m)=binom(m+k-1,k-1) yields exact positive two-total sum and one-dimensional geometric resummation. In R<=m<=epsilon/beta, the summand is beta^-k/(J^k(k-1)!m)(1+O(1/R+epsilon)); small/large tails are only O(beta^-k). The harmonic bulk gives the coefficient; replacing J by (1+t)J proves the joint Uniform/Gamma Laplace law on interior log windows. Both totals diverge, so conditional composition shares converge independently to simplex Lebesgue (Dirichlet). Beta temperature tilt gives Gamma energy and moment uniform integrability. Independent direct truncated double sums agree with independently resummed series for k=1,2,3 at beta=.4.
